title: SEC2: process_update holds lock across multiple DB operations
description: In kith-chat/src/message.rs process_update (lines 431-458), the store lock is held across 4 sequential DB operations: update_read_at, message get, contact get, and enqueue_receipt. While safe for single-threaded Phase 1, lock could be released after update_read_at and re-acquired for receipt path (message lookup, contact lookup, enqueue are all idempotent fallible ops). This is a minor optimization opportunity, not a bug.
